detail: Built a decided card auth via CLI, ran `werk add login --title 'Use magic links' --parent auth`: printed 'proposed', log +1 event; `werk show login` showed the title, proposed, refines auth and a rollup line.
Second add of login exited 1 with duplicate-id, log count unchanged, show login still had first title.
add --status decided exited 1 with message that decided comes only through the status verb; no new event; show pay says unknown card. (Wording 'not allowed on add' matched as 'not through ... add'.)
add '#login' --title '#1 priority: magic links' --parent '#auth' printed proposed; show '#login' and show 'login' gave identical output with refines auth and the full title.

Hand-wrote log with a bad unknown-parent line between auth and login; show login prints Login as proposed, stderr lists 'problem at log line 2: unknown-card'; log file unchanged. The 'problems' ask was mapped to the show verb, the only place problems print.

Playwright: decided root, wrote a chat log, `werk quote root pricing ...` printed 'proposed'; the card page shows the excerpt row with is-proposed and a 'pending' link tag; root stays decided with its words.

Playwright: opened the excerpt's page, clicked the ✓ (Accept the proposal); the ✓ went away, and on the root card page the excerpt row under 'Evidence and excerpts' has no ghost class and no pending tag.

Removed decided auth with login and session and a link login->audit: one new event, show of all three refuses, `removed` lists all, audit no longer shows the link; restore brought back children and link; removed prints 'nothing is removed'.
remove auth --reparent: login and session refine platform; after restore they refine auth and not platform.
Removed login and session, restored login: link absent; restored session: link depends_on session shows.
Removed login; source rfc-6749 still shows and billing's Ev lists it; add login refused with message naming restore; no new event, login not in map.
`werk remove login` without --actor exited non-zero; login still shows; no new event.
`werk restore login` without --actor exited non-zero; login still absent; no new event.
